## Positioning (honest)

- **Claims require artifacts** — soak reports, lab scripts, industrial gates, evidence packs.
- **Two trees on purpose** — Hybrid stays freeze-safe; Experimental absorbs transport / Long-Range risk.
- **Gaps stay visible** — [MAINNET_GAP_ANALYSIS](https://github.com/Gruver87/Absolute_Blockchain_Ultimate_Hybrid/blob/master/docs/MAINNET_GAP_ANALYSIS.md) · Experimental blockers in [EXECUTION_ORDER](https://github.com/Gruver87/experimental/blob/main/docs/EXECUTION_ORDER.md).
